label: conditional
operation: target activity android:enabled="false" but enabled activity-alias with same intent-filter targets it => entry still reachable via alias
must_not_report: target disabled by android:enabled=false treated as unreachable while enabled alias targets it

explorer_expected.notes: 反向防漏样例（2026-08-29 shop 5.54 动态实证）：直启 enabled=false 的 ShareImageReceiverActivity 被禁（result code=-92），但经 ShareImageActivityAlias 启动 result code=0 且组件 onCreate 实际执行（18ms 后应用自身发出 ShopPlugin://com.xiaomi.shop2.plugin.webview.RootFragment 深链 = startGoWebView 动作）；'target disabled = 不可达'的过度抑制不成立。sink 偏好写仅在 !hasInitCta()（隐私未同意）分支，已初始化设备休眠——故 conditional 不进二元命中（见 docs/analysis/explorer-track/2026-08-29-t1v3-poc-verification.md §2 B/§3 3.1）
